changelog: New: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server — drive Densa Deck from Claude desktop, ulcagent, Cursor, or any AI client that speaks MCP. 17 free tools always; 11 Pro tools when a license is active. Run `densa-deck mcp serve` to start the local stdio server.

New: Operator controls — MTG_ENGINE_MCP=disabled env (or {"mcp_enabled": false} in config) for full kill switch. `--read-only` drops every Pro tool. `--tools name1,name2` curates the exposed surface (helps smaller-context AI clients).
New: docs/MCP-OPERATOR.md — full operator guide with 5 copy-pasteable recipes (default, privacy-paranoid, smaller-context, corporate-disabled, coach-only).
Prior: Inno Setup installer + portable ZIP (shipped in v0.3.0).
Prior: Commander Spellbook combo integration — every analytical layer is combo-aware (shipped in v0.3.0).
